title: DynamoDB, API Gateway, Step Functions & Cognito
summary: The serverless building blocks around Lambda: Amazon DynamoDB (keys, capacity modes, DAX, Streams, global tables, TTL, backups, S3 export and import), Amazon API Gateway (integrations, endpoint types, security, custom domains), AWS Step Functions for workflows, and Amazon Cognito user pools and identity pools for app users, including per-user row-level access to DynamoDB.
